note: Great session. Pattern 5 (open 5th) is green, and with the beat on you were 100% on the click (within a few thousandths of a second). Pattern 4 (broken chord in 4s) is green too, but unevenly: most cards wobbled 40–60%, meaning some notes waited longer than others. Chord Trainer, A minor, left hand from memory: about 1.3 s per chord, which is solid. Earlier (19 Nov): G minor both hands from memory 12/12, and Pattern 3 green. The open 5th unlocks the Right-Hand Trainer.

items.title: Pattern Trainer · 4 · Broken chord in 4s, with the 🥁 beat
items.why: It's green, but uneven (40–60% wobble). Your open-5th run with the beat was perfect, so the beat clearly works for you: one round of broken 4s with the click at 60 will even it out.

items.title: Two-Hand Trainer · 2 · Right holds, left steady
items.why: With the open 5th green, this is the last step before Two-Hand 7 (smooth changes) and the smooth-shapes pad in the Jam.

items.title: Right-Hand Trainer · 1 · Melody note on each chord
items.why: Newly unlocked by the open 5th: the left hand holds the open 5th, and the right hand plays one tune note per chord. This is the first real two-hand kumzitz skill.
